title: Refund policy
text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are returned to the original payment method after approval.

title: Security guide
text: Account passwords are stored using a salted, adaptive password hashing algorithm. Support staff cannot view a customer's plaintext password.

title: Support hours
text: The support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time.
